bootstrap.cluster: family_id (FOLDS.json question family; the same 1486 families in all seven models)
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile interval (numpy.nanpercentile 2.5, 97.5, linear interpolation); draws in which the class has no within-group variation are NaN and ignored
bootstrap.resampling: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).multinomial(n_families, uniform, size=draws) over the sorted union of family ids; the SAME draws are used for every model, outcome, class and for the pooled estimate

estimator_spec.controls: fixed effect for (question, absolute-position bin of reasoning_tok_start); bin edges 0,256,512,1024,2048,4096,8192,16384,32768,inf, bin = [edge_i, edge_i+1). NO relative position and NO trace fixed effects (both leak the outcome).
estimator_spec.dedup: Within a trace, rows sharing the same context_hash (identical judge input; repetition loops) are reduced to the first occurrence by sentence_index. Rows of distinct sentences are never merged otherwise; (trace_digest, sentence_index) is unique in the source tables.
estimator_spec.estimator: OLS with the question x bin fixed effects absorbed by within-group demeaning (Frisch-Waugh-Lovell); beta_c = sum(w x~ y)/sum(w x~^2), x~ = x minus its group mean. beta is the difference in the expected outcome when the current sentence is class c versus not, at the same absolute position bin of the same question.
estimator_spec.opposite_sign_in: per cell and outcome, the sensitivity variants (no_dedup, ipw, poscontrol) in which the OPPOSITE non-zero sign to a non-zero primary sign is obtained; dataset_fe changes the estimand and is excluded from this flag.
estimator_spec.outcome_acc: y = strict_correct (math_verify) of the trace; truncated traces count as incorrect (y = 0 even where a value is stored); non-truncated traces without a strict_correct value (unscored) are dropped. Pre-registered accuracy outcome (beta_acc).
estimator_spec.outcome_acc_excl_trunc: as outcome_acc but truncated traces are excluded.
estimator_spec.outcome_tok_reason: y = log1p(n_reasoning_tokens - (reasoning_tok_start + n_tokens)), i.e. log1p of the REASONING tokens remaining after the sentence. The completion-token end position of a sentence is not stored in the native tables, so this is the primary token outcome (beta_tok). Sentences of truncated traces (termination == length) are excluded.
estimator_spec.outcome_tok_total: y = log1p(completion_tokens - (reasoning_tok_start + n_tokens)) = log1p of remaining reasoning tokens plus the answer tokens after the reasoning. Same sample as tok_reason. Reported as a secondary token outcome; it is not the pre-registered test statistic.
estimator_spec.pooled: per class, the unweighted mean of the eight model estimates (models equally weighted), recomputed in every bootstrap draw with the shared family draws.
estimator_spec.population: NATIVE judge-labelled reasoning sentences (Qwen3.8-27B GEPA judge, campaign-v3 labels), seven models; rows with a null label dropped. The labelled sentences are a stratified SUBSET of each trace.
estimator_spec.regressor: x_s = 1[label(s) == c], one separate regression per class c (one-versus-rest)

sensitivity_variants.dataset_fe: primary with (dataset, position bin) fixed effects instead of (question, position bin): a BETWEEN-question association that is confounded by question difficulty but, unlike the primary, is not limited for the trace-level accuracy outcome to the few questions with several attempts
sensitivity_variants.poscontrol: primary plus a within-group linear control for log1p(reasoning_tok_start) (addresses the coarse position bins; the first bin spans 256 tokens)

estimator_spec.sign_convention_acc: beta_acc > 0: class-c sentences are more frequent in correct traces.
estimator_spec.sign_convention_tok: beta_tok > 0: a sentence of class c is followed by MORE remaining tokens than other sentences at the same position (longer path); beta_tok < 0: fewer remaining tokens (shorter path).
estimator_spec.unit: one labelled reasoning sentence s of a trace
estimator_spec.weights: PRIMARY: unweighted (each labelled sentence counts once). 1/p design weights are NOT used because (i) trace_inclusion_probability is NULL for all cohort-B-only traces, whose own arm_inclusion_probability_b belongs to a different design, (ii) 1/p cuts the effective number of traces (Kish ESS 223-303 of 1,593-1,813 traces per model, p coalesced), moving the estimand toward the few questions with many attempts, and (iii) the test later averages over families with equal weight. The 1/p variant is reported as a sensitivity analysis (w = 1/trace_inclusion_probability, else 1/arm_inclusion_probability_b).

note: Frozen estimator, draws and seed of the pre-registration. The cells of the seven pre-registered models equal the predecessor's (checked to float rounding); LFM2.5 (no native table at pre-registration) is estimated after its interventions ran, and the pooled row is now the eight-model mean.
purpose: Outcome-blind prediction of the sign of the token / accuracy effect of pushing a MoE reasoning model toward each Schoenfeld class, from native associations only.

script.git_tree_note: working tree had uncommitted changes when run

test.association_not_causation: beta values are native associations; a failed prediction is a result about the efficiency link, not about the estimator.
test.excluded_from_test: target_deactivate arms, strengths other than central, and any predictor not stored in this receipt. The secondary statistics are reported but do not decide whether the prediction is supported.
test.expected_direction: Activating class c should change tokens in the direction of beta_tok(m,c): a POSITIVE Spearman correlation between beta_tok(m,c) and Delta_tok(m,c) is predicted. For accuracy a POSITIVE correlation between beta_acc(m,c) and Delta_acc(m,c) is predicted.
test.frozen_predictors: beta_tok(m,c) (outcome tok_reason) and beta_acc(m,c) (outcome acc) exactly as in this file; they are not re-estimated.
test.measured_accuracy_effect: Delta_acc(m,c) = mean over families f of [ accuracy of target_activate - accuracy of random_activate ] at central strength (same cells and pairing as Delta_tok)
test.measured_token_effect: Delta_tok(m,c) = mean over question families f of [ mean log(total tokens) over target_activate executions of cell (m,c) in f at central strength  -  mean log(total tokens) over random_activate executions of the matched random control at central strength in f ]
test.name: efficiency_link_predicted_vs_measured
primary_statistics: Spearman rank correlation rho_tok between beta_tok(m,c) and Delta_tok(m,c) over all usable cells
Spearman rank correlation rho_acc between beta_acc(m,c) and Delta_acc(m,c) over all usable cells

sign agreement rate: among cells whose pre-registered sign is + or - (CI excludes 0), the share where sign(Delta) equals the predicted sign (point estimate of Delta; cells with Delta exactly 0 count as disagreement), with an exact two-sided binomial test against 0.5; computed separately for tokens and accuracy
secondary_statistics: the same rho and agreement statistics with the secondary predictors stored in this receipt: tok_total, acc_excl_trunc, and the between-question dataset_fe estimates (sensitivity.dataset_fe.cells[].tok_reason / .acc)
rho_tok and rho_acc restricted to the cells whose primary sign is + or - and whose 'opposite_sign_in' list is empty (sign not reversed by no_dedup, ipw or poscontrol)
test.status: pre-specified before any intervention outcome exists
test.support_criterion: the prediction is supported for tokens (accuracy) if the 95% interval of rho_tok (rho_acc) lies above 0; it is not supported otherwise. The sign-agreement rate is reported alongside, with its binomial p-value.
test.uncertainty: family-cluster bootstrap of the INTERVENTION side only: resample families with replacement (same 2,000 draws / seed 20261017 as here, over the families of the intervention study), recompute every Delta(m,c), then rho and the agreement rate; 95% percentile intervals. The pre-registered beta values are held fixed.
test.unit_of_analysis: cell = (model, class) with a nominated layer set and a native estimate: at most 8 models x 7 classes = 56 cells
